scope: post-fix stability review after consistency changes

findings.title: skillsSlice.ts listSkills consumer uses stale flat-array shape
findings.description: skillsSlice.ts checked Array.isArray(response.data) after listSkills type changed to { skills: [...] }

findings.title: SkillTab.tsx listSkills consumer uses stale flat-array shape
findings.description: SkillTab.tsx checked Array.isArray(skillsResult.data) instead of skillsResult.data?.skills

findings.title: PluginPanel.tsx local PluginResult.evidence type mismatch (string[] vs string)
findings.description: PluginPanel local interface had evidence: string[] but backend returns string
findings.fix: Changed evidence: string, PluginInfo.dimension to optional, updated rendering to display string directly

findings.title: graphGetForeshadows default status parameter inconsistency
findings.description: graphGetForeshadows had status: string = 'pending' but endpoint expected no default filter
findings.fix: Changed to status?: string across engine, service interface, and endpoint layers

findings.title: writing.ts decision derivation uses typeof instead of Number.isFinite
findings.description: typeof result.total_score === 'number' passes for NaN; decision would be HUMAN_REVIEW for NaN

findings.title: PluginPanel.tsx PluginInfo.dimension is required but backend makes it optional
findings.description: PluginInfo.dimension was string (required) but backend omits it for some plugins
findings.fix: Changed dimension?: string to match api/plugins.ts PluginInfo

findings.title: appStore.test.ts listSkills mock uses stale flat-array shape
findings.description: Test mocks returned data: [...] but refreshAvailableSkills now expects data.skills
findings.fix: Updated all mock data to data: { skills: [...] } shape

findings.title: SkillTab.test.tsx listSkills mock uses stale flat-array shape
findings.description: Test mocks returned data: [...] but SkillTab now expects data.skills
findings.fix: Updated all mock data to data: { skills: [...] } shape

findings.title: knowledge.additional.test.ts still uses double-envelope mock shapes
findings.description: After removing double-envelope types, test mocks still had data: { success: true, data: {...} }
findings.fix: Removed inner envelope from all mock data and assertions (data.total instead of data.data.total)

findings.title: adapters.ts getForeshadows signature still requires status: string
findings.description: Container adapter had status: string (required) while engine changed to status?: string
findings.fix: Changed to status?: string to match engine and service layers

findings.title: evaluateNovelQuality called with 2 args but only accepts 1
findings.description: writing.ts passed qualityKwargs as second argument to evaluateNovelQuality which only takes content
findings.fix: Removed qualityKwargs argument from evaluateNovelQuality call (was TS2554 error)
